dedupe_keys.name: the cipher platform cyberattack impacts patient harms emergency response

description: The CIPHER deposit publishes a patient-harm dataset associated with hospital cyberattacks. Isabel Straw, Jeffrey Tully and Christian Dameff release version 1.0.1 through a Zenodo snapshot of the CIPHER website repository. The metadata identify data/v1_cipherdata_latest.csv as the initial public dataset and distinguish CC BY 4.0 for data from Apache-2.0 for code. Both permit free reuse. Event observations could help construct scenarios in which digital failures disrupt healthcare services, but the short description does not establish complete country coverage, incident dates, row counts or reporting thresholds. The geographical classification reflects the absence of a fixed local implementation, not a claim of worldwide completeness. No patient-level files were inspected and no causal assessment was performed. Although the title uses the word platform, this draft represents the explicitly described event dataset. No related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
